elements.requirement: A person who attends voluntarily at a police station or at any other place where a constable is present, for the purpose of assisting with an investigation and without having been arrested, is entitled to leave at will unless he is placed under arrest.
elements.quote: attends voluntarily at a police station or at any other place where a constable is present

elements.requirement: A person who accompanies a constable to a police station or any other place where a constable is present, for the purpose of assisting with an investigation and without having been arrested, is entitled to leave at will unless he is placed under arrest.
elements.quote: accompanies a constable to a police station or any such other place without having been arrested

elements.requirement: A person who attends voluntarily or accompanies a constable to assist with an investigation ceases to be entitled to leave at will if he is placed under arrest.
elements.quote: unless he is placed under arrest

elements.requirement: A person attending voluntarily or accompanying a constable to assist with an investigation without having been arrested must be informed at once that he is under arrest if a constable takes a decision to prevent him from leaving at will.
elements.quote: he shall be informed at once that he is under arrest if a decision is taken by a constable to prevent him from leaving at will
